name: DRS rule compliance report
summary: Checks DRS VM-VM rules (existence, members, placement) and host memory over-commit for a cluster.
description: Read-only. Checks every VM-VM DRS rule of the cluster (enabled, placement: separate = one powered-on member per host, together = same host) and the expected rules listed for the cluster in the data file "Expected DRS rules" (exists, type, exact members). Adds host allocation (vRAM over-commit, memory used, vCPU:core, swap / balloon, large VMs per host), a VM detail table for VMs matching a name pattern (e.g. SQL), pending DRS recommendations and decommission candidates.

inputs.name: VmNamePattern
inputs.label: VM detail name pattern
inputs.help: Regular expression for the VM detail table (default from the data file, e.g. (?i)sql). Empty = data file value.
